subject: grey seal
title: Seals Kept Washing Up With Spiral Cuts. The Killer Was Another Seal

scenes.text: Dead seals kept washing ashore with one perfect spiral cut.
Around Scotland, 86 turned up in five years. The wound wrapped around the body like a corkscrew.
Ship propellers got the blame. Some scientists suspected sharks.
Then researchers on the Isle of May watched an adult male grey seal catch a weaned pup, kill it, and eat it.
He took five pups in one week. Their wounds were the same clean spiral.
So the corkscrew killer was never a machine. It was one of their own.

description:
For years, dead seals washed ashore around Scotland with a single smooth cut spiralling around the body.
Between 2009 and 2014, 86 such carcasses were recorded. The wounds were first put down to ducted ship propellers, and some researchers suggested sharks. Then an adult male grey seal on the Isle of May, Scotland, was watched catching, killing and eating five weaned grey seal pups over one week. Nine more carcasses nearby had similar injuries, and in 12 of the 14 examined the wounds were indistinguishable from those blamed on propellers (Brownlow and colleagues, PLoS ONE, 2016). Propellers are not ruled out entirely, but they are now thought much less likely to be the main cause.
Did you see that ending coming? Comment below.
first_comment: The first suspects were ducted ship propellers and sharks. Who did you think it was before the last line?
